data.subject: FRST filing and Local Ledger
data.body:
Hi,

North Reef Capital’s June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in FRST, MYFW, and COSO.

On August 31, 2026, FRST disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1325670/000110465926103947/tm2624389d1_8k.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
